svg.title: The Token Tax: this tokenizer vs GPT-4 on Tigrigna
svg.desc: Bar chart of token counts per test text. GPT-4 cl100k_base needs 904 tokens in total against 240 for this Ge'ez-aware tokenizer, a 3.77 times factor and 73.5 percent saving, up to 8 times on a news sentence. On the English control text this tokenizer is worse, 70 tokens against 10.
svg.text: TOKENS NEEDED PER TEST TEXT · LOWER IS BETTER
cl100k_base was fit mostly on other
scripts. On six Tigrigna texts it used
◄ the trade-off of a small Ge'ez vocab
7 texts incl. the English control · 1,059 bytes
